name: Brunhild Hammerfall
title: Forgemistress
description: A stout dwarf with copper braids tied back from the heat and a leather apron scored by a thousand sparks. She talks about crossbows the way other people talk about their children.

greeting.first_time: Brunhild Hammerfall. This is the Anvilheart, and that is clan steel, not the soft stuff they hammer out in the capital. What are you after?
greeting.returning: Back for more dwarven work? Sensible.
greeting.low_gold: I've bought enough scrap for one day. Come back tomorrow.

sleeping.text: *Snoring like a bellows, and just as loud.*

traveling_to_work.text: Forge lights at six. A dwarf who sleeps past dawn is a dwarf who's ill.

traveling_home.text: The Anvilheart's banked for the night. Come back at six.

off_duty.text: Not now. Forge opens at six, and not a minute sooner.

browse_shop.text: Mind your fingers on the heavy crossbow. It doesn't care whose they are.

ask_about_crossbows.text: The Hammerfall clan has strung crossbows for nine generations. Nobody else in the realm makes them, and nobody else sells bolts that fly true. The little hand crossbows? Bah. Toys for assassins. You'll take those off a dead goblin chief, not buy them from me.

goodbye.text: Go well. Keep your edge sharp and your string waxed.
